crossRefs.note: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
both young men and maidens; old men and children:
Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with…
Miriam answered them, “Sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. The horse and his rider he has thrown into the…
The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.
The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
the sun to rule by day; for his loving kindness endures forever;
the moon and stars to rule by night; for his loving kindness endures forever:
God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not…

translations.web: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
translations.bsb: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.
translations.kjv: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
translations.asv: Day unto day uttereth speech, And night unto night showeth knowledge.
